description:
Reconcile historical reset-module documentation and current developer image guidance after SCR SDLC migration. Add clear current-versus-historical index linking root RELEASE.md, contracts/, evidence/feasibility/, evidence/revision-*, retained legacy REQ, dirty legacy workspace evidence, and active ITM-0001. Root RELEASE.md stops at revision 6/no DEB; later legacy workspace contains production source and package work. Old contracts still prescribe SRC/reset reasons superseded by observable-boot scope. Preserve original historical bytes, hashes, canonical paths, and references; prefer additive index/supersession records over deleting or rewriting hashed evidence. Update docs/DEVELOPER-GUIDE.md procedures to current lock-held disposable-image rules; remove guidance that can imply original raw-image mutation and include current Codex entry points while retaining supported Claude tooling. Inventory tracked .codex/REQ-0001-revision-15-solution-plan.tmp.md and .codex/task-plan-rev15/ as historical artifacts; identify exact duplicates and retain unique material through explicit archive/index before any removal from active-looking paths. Acceptance: current module scope, actual acceptance limits, pending plan, safe image procedures, and authoritative locations are unambiguous; historical evidence remains intact and linked. No approval of ITM-0001, legacy resumption, hardware access, image mutation, or quarantine change.

Migration-chain ownership: depend on ITM-0004 actual retained command/safety interfaces and use ITM-0005 evidence/disposition references. Own independently useful historical index and current developer guidance; every link must resolve at this item's completion. Use stable archive/provenance entry points so later ITM-0006 can publish its final manifest without breaking this index. ITM-0006 owns final workspace archive, canonical module source handoff, compiler prerequisite fix, and readiness evidence; do not split this item's promised documentation acceptance into that later item. Document offline rebuild readiness separately from pending hardware/image acceptance. Do not rewrite hashed historical contracts or claim migration completion before later readiness verification.
